sentences.text:
This appeal has been filed against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 21.06.2025 passed by learned Special Judge, CBI-I, Patna in Special Case No. 51 of 2011, RC No.
30/A/91, CIS No. 2317 of 2014,

whereby and whereunder appellant has been convicted for the offence under section 120/B read with section 409, 420, 467, 468, 477/A I.P.C. along with section 13(1)(C)(D) read with section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act and has been sentenced to undergo Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.3356 of 2025(2) dt.08-09-2025 rigorous imprisonment for three years separately in all the sections alongwith fine of Rs. 25,000/- each.
In default of payment of fine, appellant has been ordered to undergo simple imprisonment for six months.
All the sentences have been directed to run concurrently.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that this appeal has been filed within time and maximum sentence of three years has been imposed upon the appellant under sections 120/B read with section 409, 420, 467, 468, 477/A I.P.C. along with section 13(1)(C)(D) read with section 13(2)
of the Prevention of Corruption Act and the appellant has got privilege under Section 389(3) of the Cr. P.C. thereby granting provisional bail and he is still on provisional bail and accordingly, a prayer has been made to confirm the said provisional bail.
5. Learned A.P.P. has no objection to the prayer for confirmation of provisional bail.
6.

Considering the above submissions, the provisional bail granted to the appellant is hereby confirmed on the same bail bond taken by the convicting trial court and the appellant will be treated as on bail during the pendency of this appeal.
7. Sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal.

APP (SJ) No.3356 of 2025(2) dt.08-09-2025 8. Put up the appeal under appropriate heading on 13.10.2025 or on receipt of the trial court records, whichever is earlier.
(Alok Kumar Pandey, J) mcverma/-
